description: This source file defines the LabelReferences class, which analyzes various project files to find references to UI labels, including from FTL templates, Java and Groovy source code, and XML configurations related to the Ofbiz framework. It builds a map of label usages across the project.

classes.name: LabelReferences
classes.description: A class responsible for scanning project files to find references to UI labels, building a map of references keyed by label keys and file locations.

methods.name: getLabelReferences
methods.description: Main method that orchestrates scanning various file types for label references and compiling the reference map.

methods.name: setLabelReference
methods.description: Records a reference to a label key from a specific file path and updates the count.

methods.name: getLabelsFromFtlFiles
methods.description: Scans FreeMarker template files for label references.

methods.name: getLabelsFromJavaFiles
methods.description: Scans Java source files for label references.

methods.name: getLabelsFromGroovyFiles
methods.description: Scans Groovy source files for label references.

methods.name: getLabelsFromOfbizComponents
methods.description: Scans ofbiz component XML files for labels related to webapp components.

methods.name: checkOfbizComponentTag
methods.description: Checks XML elements for 'webapp' tags to find label references.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsEntityTag
methods.description: Extracts fields from entity tags in XML, adding label references for entity-field related labels.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsTag
methods.description: Parses tooltip attributes in XML form fields to find label references.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsServiceTag
methods.description: Analyzes service parameter definitions to find label references in auto-generated forms.

methods.name: getWebappTag
methods.description: Extracts label references from webapp tags' title attributes if displayed in the app bar.

methods.name: getLabelsFromSimpleMethodFiles
methods.description: Scans XML files in specific directories for label references.

methods.name: getLabelsFromFormWidgets
methods.description: Parses form XML files to find form-specific label references, including within nested elements.
